_about: Long-climb fragment (List 30 #292) — Mt. Battle native as #186's big form. The spine, kept verbatim for landing: the ladder is a run; the climb is a campaign. Zero facilities instanced; hosts/names are #86's owner-content register.

coupons.class: facility currency — display name rides the standing currency-name question, NOT coined here
coupons.convertibility: never to the world currency; valid only inside the facility family (#20 faucets untouched)
coupons.paid_by: seats + zone completions (values are facility data)

gain: no #177 events (levels normalised per #86) — rewards are coupons, records, honours
generation: #94 contract verbatim, banded and authored, never reading the visitor (#52 B1/B2); zone leader seat closes each zone (generated at band-top; a named leader is #186's HEAD casting slot)

persistence.loss: restarts the CURRENT ZONE at seat 1; that zone's unbanked seat coupons forfeited; the climb never resets short of a recorded retirement
persistence.save: climb record rides #96's payload (absent = no climb started)
persistence.vs_186: #186 run = one attempt, ends at first loss, one record line. Climb = zone progress persists between sessions; withdrawal between zones is free
persistence.withdrawal: between zones, free; the record says the climb waits

record.seatFacts: append-only seat history — best marks and coupons derive at read (#14 law)
record.shape: 10 zones x 10 seats = 100 is the documented shape; both numbers are facility data

tower_circuits: the same record's second form: fixed seat lists + entry classes (#86 format slots); clears recorded once; re-runs pay reduced coupons (data)
